title: The 4 Focuses of History-Makers

exampleSpecs.audience: makers losing depth to shallow inputs

exampleSpecs.audience: people protecting time but not improving skill
exampleSpecs.stakes: protected time without deliberate refinement can stagnate
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Tie personal mastery practice to craft and inner refinement

exampleSpecs.stakes: large identity claims collapse without repeated high-quality days
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply Day stacking as daily construction

exampleSpecs.stakes: comparison can starve a distinctive capacity
